note: Scotland County GIS (ArcGIS Online web map 7a41450aee5b4c5daac5e43d347dd751, services.arcgis.com/mq0BGE5kHpm8mHFz) publishes boundaries, road centerlines, address points and emergency-service districts, but no zoning layer. The county website has no zoning map. Memphis (the county seat) zoning code says the official zoning map is kept on paper at City Clerk, City Engineer and Planning and Zoning offices, with no online GIS. No city or town in the county was found publishing zoning as a queryable service.
